# anomaly_integration (Data Source)

Looks up a single nxs-anomaly integration by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object. Alternatively, supply id instead of name.
data "anomaly_integration" "example" {
  name = "Prometheus"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID to look up. Supply either id or the name/username lookup attribute.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `group_by` (List of String)
- `heartbeat` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--heartbeat))
- `kafka_topic` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `legacy_pool` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legacy_pool))
- `notification_policy` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_policy))
- `pipeline` (String) Ingest pipeline as a JSON array of stages. Runs after route selection, so it shapes deduplication, the stored alert and the notification text but never moves which escalation chain pages.
- `provisioned_by` (String) Name of the infrastructure-as-code tool that owns this object, absent when a person created it.
- `routes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `source_type` (String)
- `team_id` (String)
- `templates` (Map of String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
